name: two-tanks-cascade
note: Two PID loops with an SCP scaling block and a MOV, feeding an analogue output. The analogue inputs are held: %IW68 sets a 50 % setpoint, %IW66 and %IW64 are the two loops' processes. The alarm bit %I0.3 pulses in the middle. The loops themselves are traced as reals with a declared tolerance.
